tasks.title: Decision confidence calibration from realized outcomes
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: Closed loop: realized decision outcomes feed back into the confidence the system presents. Buckets with fewer than 5 outcomes produce no adjustment; measured buckets report observed improvement rate versus stated confidence, a deterministic shrinkage estimate and an overconfident/aligned/underconfident verdict. No LLM-generated numbers; ledger API and UI expose the same payload.
tasks.evidence: Full suite 77 files/719 tests passed (9 skipped); eslint clean; tsc --noEmit clean; production build succeeded. Calibration math covered by tests/decision-calibration.test.ts (sample gating, shrinkage, clamping, partial status, bucket boundaries, end-to-end summarizeDecisionLearning -> buildDecisionCalibration) and asserted through the /api/decision-ledger summary in tests/decision-ledger.test.ts.

tasks.title: Surface confidence calibration in decision case list
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: When an executive opens a decision case, the stated confidence is accompanied by the organization’s own observed outcome record for that confidence band (or an explicit insufficient-evidence note). Data stays org-scoped and derived from stored outcomes only.
tasks.evidence: Full suite 77 files/720 tests passed (9 skipped); eslint and tsc clean; production build succeeded. API test asserts calibration payload, sample gating and cross-org isolation.

tasks.title: Causal links carry evidence metadata for deterministic grading

tasks.evidence: Full suite 78 files/723 tests passed (9 skipped); eslint and tsc clean; production build succeeded. New API tests assert metadata round-trip, RCT+n=120+high quality grading to high evidence, 400s for invalid method/quality/confidence, and null metadata by default.
